name: Midnight Carnivore (Legendary Druid Archetype)
body:
Death is a part of nature, as almost every creature is preyed upon and eaten by others. Legendary druids accept this truth, and some druids go as far as studying the methods of hunting beasts.

Skills: The midnight carnivore adds Stealth to their skill list and removes Heal from their skill list. This modifies skills.

Studied Target: The legendary druid gains the studied target ability of a slayer of equal level. They may only have one studied target at a time, and do not gain the ability to study a target as a swift action.

Sneak Attack

At 4th level, the legendary druid gains the ability to make sneak attacks as a rogue. They do an additional 1d6 damage with such attacks at 4th level, plus an additional 1d6 for every 4 levels thereafter, to a total of 5d6 at 20th level.

This damage stacks with sneak attack bonuses from other sources.

This replaces druidic circle.

Whenever the midnight carnivore gains a minor talent, they may choose a slayer talent instead.

Whenever the midnight carnivore gains a major talent, they may choose an advanced slayer talent instead.

Druidic Talents

The following talents are available to midnight carnivores:

Hunter’s Magic (Minor Talent) (Ex)

Choose a spell from the ranger spell list. You gain that as a spell known at the same spell level.

Stalker

(Major Talent)

The legendary druid gains his studied target bonus on Disguise. Intimidate, and Stealth checks against his studied opponent.

Swift Studied Target

(Major Talent)

The legendary druid may use their studied target ability as a swift action.
